title: SALSA-V: Shortcut-Augmented Long-form Synchronized Audio from Videos
abstract: arXiv:2510.02916v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We propose SALSA-V, a multimodal video-to-audio generation model capable of synthesizing highly synchronized, high-fidelity long-form audio from silent video content. Our approach introduces a masked diffusion objective, enabling audio-conditioned generation and the seamless synthesis of unconstrained length audio sequences. Additionally, by integrating a shortcut loss into our training process, we achieve rapid generation of high-quality audio samples in as few as eight sampling steps, paving the way for near-real-time applications without requiring dedicated fine-tuning or retraining. We demonstrate that SALSA-V significantly outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods in both audiovisual alignment and synchronization with video content in quantitative evaluation and a human listening study. Furthermore, our use of random masking during training enables our model to match spectral characteristics of reference audio samples,

translated_title: SALSA-V：从视频生成带快捷增强的长格式同步音频
translated_abstract: 我们提出了SALSA-V，一种多模态视频到音频生成模型，能够从无声视频内容中合成高度同步、高保真的长格式音频。我们的方法引入了掩码扩散目标，实现了音频条件生成和无约束长度音频序列的无缝合成。此外，通过在训练过程中整合快捷损失，我们能够在仅需八步采样的情况下快速生成高质量音频样本，为近实时应用铺平了道路，而无需专门的微调或重新训练。我们证明，在定量评估和人类听力研究中，SALSA-V在视听对齐和与视频内容的同步方面显著优于现有最先进方法。此外，我们在训练期间使用随机掩码，使模型能够匹配参考音频样本的频谱特征。
tldr: SALSA-V通过掩码扩散和快捷损失技术，实现了从无声视频高效生成高保真、长格式同步音频，仅需八步采样即可达到近实时性能，并在同步性和质量上显著超越现有方法。
en_tdlr: SALSA-V leverages masked diffusion and shortcut loss to efficiently generate high-fidelity, long-form synchronized audio from silent videos in as few as eight sampling steps, achieving near-real-time performance and significantly outperforming existing methods in synchronization and quality.
